text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- Basque PNV party gives the government an ultimatum to set the "cupo", the payments the region has to give the central state as compensation for public services.
- Three board members of Spanish pay television Sogecable were banned from leaving the country by the judge Liano
EL MUNDO
- Economy Minister Rato promised to cut taxes from 1999
- Spanish King bases European stability on cooperation with Russia.
- Basque PNV leader Ardanza ruled out his candidacy for a second term
DIARIO 16
- Euphoria -- Rato promises to cut taxes, Car sales up 20 percent in April, Stocks hit record high expecting a rate cut
- Judge Liano keeps Carlos March (Sogecable board member) in Spain.
CINCO DIAS
- Surgery for BEX (Banco Exterior de Espana) to heal Argentaria
-Financial analysts set Bourse index at 550 points
- Investgations over fiscal bribery in the western region of Valencia
- Budget deficit improved in April, but social security owes 200 trillion to the State
- Spanish Treasury cuts long term yields
EXPANSION
- Argentaria prepared a drastic plan to cut staff to save its subsidiary BEX
- Treasury makes good use of better trend in the markets, bet over a fresh rate cut
- Financial regions begin to worry over their new financing system
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Argentaria will reduce BEX staff to save it
- PREVER plan boosted car sales in April, up 20 percent
- State had April budget cash surplus of 407 billion pesetas
- MIBOR fell to all-time low of 5.30 pct, suggesting a new official rate cut
- Housing won't be included in income tax anymore from 1999
-- Madrid Newsroom, + 341 585 8340
